cause: A fixed authenticator password in the shared server integration harness reaches five password sinks. It is a real test-fixture rule finding; the rule is retained. No production credentials or backend source are changed by its correction.
correction_under_validation: Generate one CSPRNG UUID-derived64-character secret per integration-test process with OnceLock; all isolated databases, repeated RLS bootstraps and the Rust SDK child consume that same generated secret.
scope: Original failed aggregate CodeQL verdict is preserved. The ordinary Rust/service check passed, but17of18 checks does not approve source CI. Final correction CI and release-byte/source equivalence still require evidence.
